what: Per-file serving ceiling for the openbiodiversity SDM migration: a Canada-wide 300 m single-band raster (upper bound; per-species SDMs are range-clipped and smaller, but the national base layers are this size).
verified: validate.py: tile 99.4% on viridis ramp; COG roundtrip max|delta| 5e-5; 6 overviews
corpus_implication: One national layer serves in ~91 MB (29 display + 62 COG). ~10 national base layers ~= 0.9 GB; ~500 range-clipped species (x up to 3 variants) are each far smaller (measured 1-7 MB display, 2-3 MB COG). Whole served corpus is single-digit GB, not the ~1 TB raw source: serving compresses the source ~50-100x.
